name: Rey Resources Limited
summary: Rey Resources Limited engages in exploring for and developing energy resources in Western Australia. It holds a 40% interest in the Canning Basin petroleum permits EP457 and EP458 (Fitzroy Blocks), and a 100% interest in the Derby Block EP487. The company also holds a 100% interest in the Lennard Shelf Blocks, which comprises a petroleum exploration license EP104, a retention license R1, and one production license L15 in the Canning Basin. In addition, it holds 100% interests in the Duchess Paradise Coal Project located in the Canning Basin. Rey Resources Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
